# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old (at the time of Anne's arrival)  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking, ungainly man with long iron-gray hair touching his stooping shoulders. He wore a full, soft brown beard continuously from the age of twenty. He rarely dressed up in a white collar and drove in a buggy unless there was an unusual occasion.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew was an extraordinarily shy, quiet, and bashful man who dreaded strangers and hated speaking in public or having to talk among people. He was deeply uncomfortable around women and little girls, though he felt comfortable with silent routine and indulged Anne's chatter. Patient, good-natured, and soft-hearted, he held fast to his opinions with an amazing silent persistency rather than arguing. He possessed a kind, sympathetic, and generous nature, often showing deep appreciation and affection for Anne silently.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c10 P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables in Avonlea with his sister Marilla. Because of his aging health and the difficulty of finding hired farm help, he and Marilla arranged to adopt a young orphan boy from Hopeton. When Matthew drove to Bright River station to collect the child, he was met instead by Anne Shirley. Despite his extreme fear of little girls, Matthew was captivated by her talkative nature and silently resolved that they should keep her. Through his gentle persistency, he convinced Marilla to let Anne remain at Green Gables. Over the following years, Matthew formed a deep bond with Anne, acting as a sympathetic confidant and frequently spoiling her with gifts such as a fashionably made dress for a school concert. He encouraged her studies and romantic spirit while suffering from increasingly frequent heart spells. Matthew died instantly of a sudden heart stroke upon reading a newspaper account of the failure of the Abbey Bank.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c28 P48](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0048), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at the isolated Green Gables homestead founded by his shy father  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Lived a quiet life keeping house with his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007)</sub>
- Suffered from heart trouble that worsened with age  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>
- Gave a little calf to Anne which he purchased from Mr. Bell  <sub>[v2 c1 P16](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0016)</sub>
